description: Check the text of a Shopify product CSV against the import rules before it is imported. Use it for "will this CSV import?", "what is wrong with my product file?". Pass csv exactly as exported or edited, header row included, up to 2 MB. Returns blocking findings (Shopify rejects them or the import comes out wrong) and warnings, up to 200 each, every one with row, handle, rule and the fix, plus totals. Nothing is stored: the file or feed is used for this answer and dropped.

csv.description: The product CSV text exactly as exported from Shopify, header row included. At most 2 MB.

name: csv_import_preflight

blocking.description: Problems Shopify rejects or that make the import wrong, at most 200

row.description: Spreadsheet row, header is row 1; 0 for the whole file

warnings.description: Problems that import but probably not as intended, at most 200

row.description: Spreadsheet row, header is row 1; 0 for the whole file

title: Check a product CSV before import
